name: notif-shows-m
title: What you missed · Shows
note: Shows: changes to a show you’re Watching (cancelled, postponed or moved, sold out, tickets back).

name: notif-alerts-m
title: What you missed · Alerts
note: Alerts: new Denver dates from artists you follow, a fixed artist report, and crew news.

name: notif-prices-m
title: What you missed · Prices
note: Prices: price drops on shows you’re Watching, and Price check results.

name: concerts-round-stamps-d
title: Concerts · one round stamp
note: Rule 4 wins: every Concerts row uses the round venue ring. The rounded-square stamp is gone.

name: passport-d
title: Passport · page 1 oldest first, untilted
note: Oldest first on every page, so the book reads like a book: page 1 starts with your first night. Stamps are round and untilted (rule 4).

name: filters-active-d
title: Filters · active, single-select
note: One venue and one vibe at a time. The segment names the choice in full (“Bluebird Theater”) with its one tile.

name: filters-where-d
title: Filters · Where, single-select
note: Picking a venue replaces the last one. The chosen row gets the tint and a check, the same mark the Who list uses. No checkboxes.

name: filters-active-m
title: Filters · active chips, mobile
note: Chips name the one venue and the one vibe.

name: filters-sheet-m
title: Filters sheet · single-select
note: One tile lit under Where, one chip lit under Vibe.

name: more-mobile
title: Admin More · no count pills
note: Only Needs you carries a badge. Counts move into the detail line as plain text.

name: desktop-sidebar-interim
title: Admin sidebar · interim Invite codes row
note: Interim only, from 0a until 5b moves Invite codes into People as a tab. Then this row goes.

name: couldnt-load
title: Admin · couldn’t load, one line
note: One line for a timeout and a render error alike.

name: load-artist-m
title: Artist page · loading
note: The skeleton is the tilted 4:5 card in the hero, at the loaded card’s size and angle, so nothing shifts when the photo lands.

name: event-nll-m
title: Event · No longer listed, mobile
note: Not cancelled: no strike, no grey photo, no red. A grey dashed card says the venue took it down. Tickets and Watch stay.

name: event-cancelled-by-crawler-m
title: Cancelled · from the venue, no fan report
note: Same banner. The source line names the venue’s calendar instead of a reporter and confirms.

name: event-cancelled-venue-link-m
title: Cancelled · no ticket link, venue site only
note: The CTA is the venue website. Never Get tickets on a cancelled show.

name: event-cancelled-no-link-m
title: Cancelled · no link at all
note: Disabled, as live: No tickets available.

name: event-tickets-back-pending-m
title: Tickets available · pending
note: Only offered on a live sold-out show. While pending, the sold-out card and CTA stay as they are.

name: event-tickets-back-live-m
title: Tickets available · confirmed
note: Confirmed means the sold-out flag clears and the page is back to normal: price, Get tickets, Watch. No banner.

name: browse-320
title: Browse at 320
note: Filters A at 320: Filters and My artists fit on one line; rows truncate the venue.

name: browse-active-320
title: Browse at 320 · filters on
note: Active chips run off the right edge and scroll, like the shelf.

name: offline-pill-320
title: Offline pill at 320
note: Under 360px the pill drops “· cached OK” and reads Offline, so search keeps its spot.

name: passport-empty-d
title: Passport · empty, desktop
note: The open book with four empty round slots, the empty block beside it, and 0 of 21 venues.

name: passport-empty-m
title: Passport · empty, mobile, untilted
note: The approved empty board with its slots untilted (rule 4).

name: notifications-panel-d
title: Notifications · desktop panel
note: The account menu panel swaps to What you missed (as live NotifMenuPanel), with Menu as the way back. Same tabs and rows as mobile.

name: venue-light-m
title: Venue page · Light, mobile
note: The neon glyph hero on Light: the backdrop goes pale and the glyph keeps its colors.

name: error-report-refused-m
title: Error page · report refused
note: Rate-limited or rejected: not saved on the device and not retried, unlike Signal lost.

name: error-in-app-m
title: Error inside the app (route error)
note: A route error renders inside the app layout, so the header and bottom nav stay. Only global-error is the bare page.

name: shelf-see-all-m
title: Coming to Denver · See all
note: See all sits on the heading row. The shelf stops at 10 cards.

name: submitted-prices-m
title: Submitted prices · venue tiles
note: No artist images: each row uses its venue tile. Title is Submitted prices (locked vocabulary).

name: counter-how-found-m
title: Price check counter · how you found out
note: The required How you found out chips sit above Submit; the honesty footnote sits under it.
